sources.snippet: The Apache 2.0 license permits commercial use but requires license preservation in derivatives. The model inherits restrictions from Stable Diffusion v2, which includes clauses about responsible use. A newer marigold-depth-v1-1 model exists with improved settings for variable step configurations, making v1-0 partially superseded for new projects.

sources.title: Marigold: Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Generators for Monocular ...
sources.snippet: Marigold is the new state-of-the-art depth estimator for images in the wild. Overview We present Marigold, a diffusion model and associated fine-tuning protocol for monocular depth estimation. Its core principle is to leverage the rich visual knowledge stored in modern generative image models.
